<!-- pr-reviewer: 99405ce30e3bc0c7a03a84fc4599ebf8c17f5723 -->
**Needs changes before merge**

Read-only docs review (no build).

Verified against main:
- Coolant modes Off, Flood, Mist and Through tool (`crates/post/src/post/coolant.rs:22-50`), with no air mode on main, as the page says.
- The "Suggest feeds & speeds" and "Apply suggestion" labels exist in the UI.
- The Carvera inch check (`assets/posts/carvera.cps:154`), G21 in `assets/posts/fanuc.cps:373`, and G43.4 in `assets/posts/doosan-dnm.cps:342`.
- `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md` and `docs/MACHINE-ONBOARDING.md` exist.
- `Fixes #1281` is satisfied: eight pages, and the index links the section.

Requested before merge:
1. Five links point at pages that are on no branch yet but in open PRs: `guide/glossary/` (#1259), `guide/machines/` (#1267), `guide/order-of-operations/` (#1283), `guide/troubleshooting/` (#1252) and `guide/workflows/` (#1271). The rule is that internal links point at pages on main or in the same PR. Either merge after those PRs and switch them to `@/guide/<page>.md` links, or hold this PR until they land.
2. `units-and-coordinates`, `workholding` and `operations-multiaxis` are on main now (the last came with #1272, merged today). Write them as `@/guide/...md` links, not absolute https URLs.

Notes (not blocking): the "no air-blast coolant" line is true today. Keep the author's note about PR #961 in mind for whichever of the two lands second.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a0d4963bac1f0a41d62d9b1a0013974aa267fc2e -->
**Needs changes before merge** (delta review of the move 99405ce -> a0d4963; read-only docs review, nothing built).

The head moved by one merge of main (parents 99405ce + d007f40) that carries the link fixes. `git show --remerge-diff` is not empty (it holds the `guide/_index.md` conflict resolution and the link edits), so I read it in full.

**Requested change 1 (link blocker): resolved.**
- The 18 absolute `https://neotech.github.io/Camcraft/guide/...` links are gone (`git grep neotech.github.io -- site/content` is empty).
- Every `@/guide/<page>.md` target exists in the merged tree: glossary, order-of-operations, troubleshooting, workflows, workholding, units-and-coordinates, operations-multiaxis.
- "Machine types" is plain text in three places (`fundamentals/_index.md`, `chips-and-coolant.md`, `post-and-machine.md`) because `guide/machines.md` is on no branch yet. That follows the merge rule. Re-link it once #1267 lands.
- The `guide/_index.md` conflict keeps both sides.

**Requested before merge (new, caused by main moving):**
1. `site/content/guide/fundamentals/chips-and-coolant.md:33-34` and `:40-43` now state something false. #961 has merged, and main has `CoolantMode::Air` (`crates/post/src/post/coolant.rs`, five modes: Off, Flood, Mist, Air, Through tool), so the page's "Off, Flood (the default), Mist or Through tool" is no longer the whole list. The paragraph "CamCraft has no separate 'air blast' mode ... set the operation to Off and turn it on at the machine" now sends users to work around a mode that exists. The page needs to list Air (a machine must state an Air / Air-blast entry for it to post, as with Through tool), and the "no air blast" paragraph should be rewritten or dropped. The author's own note on this PR said whichever of the two lands second fixes it; that is this PR. Check `post-and-machine.md` for the same claim.

**Local results:** not built (docs only, no code or dependency change; no build.rs, `.github`, script or process-file change). The author reports `zola build` green (34 pages, 0 orphan); I did not re-run it. Trial merge: GitHub reports the PR MERGEABLE.

**Notes (not blocking):** the PR body needs `Fixes #1281` and a `Changelog:` line kept as before; I did not re-check them on this head.

@mkinney: once the coolant page matches the five modes, this is ready for a re-check.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 95a5305e4a9dd1c9ceff35ea5fc58c2f98b63861 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge (re-review of the fix commit 95a5305e4).

**What looks good**
- The blocker is fixed. `chips-and-coolant.md` now lists Off, Flood (default), Mist, Air, Through tool, in the same order and with the same labels as `CoolantMode::ALL` / `label()` in `crates/post/src/post/coolant.rs`. The Air line describes an air blast that clears chips without a fluid, which matches the `Air` variant doc there.
- Default is Flood, per `#[default]` on `CoolantMode`.
- A mode the machine states no code for is refused by name rather than guessed (module doc, and `js.rs:163`: "a non-Flood ask is refused by name").
- "A machine whose only coolant is air starts new operations on Air" matches `CoolantMode::machine_default`: with no coded Flood or custom entry, it takes the first coded entry's mode.
- Internal links on the fundamentals pages all use `@/guide/...` and every target exists in the tree. The rest of the diff is unchanged since the earlier review.

**Local results merged with main**
- Trial merge with origin/main is clean. Docs only (10 files under `site/content/guide`), so no cargo build or clippy was needed. `zola` is not on PATH, so no site build was run.

**Requested before merge**
- None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- "Machine types" is still plain text in `chips-and-coolant.md:39`, `post-and-machine.md:54` and `fundamentals/_index.md:35`. The page now exists as `site/content/guide/machines.md`, so it could become `[Machine types](@/guide/machines.md)`. This is a polish item, not a blocker: the text is true and nothing is broken without the link.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
